name: Board reads
responsibility: Where a board's document, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation. A replay reads no findings and no locality.
